title: Student Survey Advisory Group Member
bio: Hello there! My name is Matthew Ruiz. I am a freshman at Harvard College, and I plan to double-concentrate in Government and History, with a secondary in Spanish. I am originally from South Florida, but now I live in Greenough Hall. Outside of class, I like to spend time with my friends and build LEGO sets.
